evals.prompt: Create a new user story issue on GitLab for automated backup retention using the glab CLI.
evals.expected_output: A glab issue create CLI call with title, description containing user story and checkbox criteria, and labels.
assertions: Uses glab issue create CLI command
Sets title clearly identifying the story
Includes description with As a / I want / So that user story structure
Includes acceptance criteria formatted as markdown checkboxes

evals.prompt: Close GitLab issue #15 after verifying all acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: A glab issue close CLI command targeting issue 15.
assertions: Confirms that acceptance criteria were verified before closure
